title: Tenzing
review:
I am Mister Amazing!! 🗣️🗣️🗣️

Film je o prvom uspešnom penjanju na Everest (i Šerpama), and man was it impactful

Neočekivan kombo kad sam video najavu, Apple-ov film, glume Tom Hiddleston i Willem Dafoe, i odmah digitalno izlazi?

Divim se planinarenju i ovaj film je izašao u pravom momentu

Svi na kraju ispadoše dragi likovi.

Ne znam još tačno kako su snimili sve ovo, ali jako ubedljivo izgleda. Everest je jeziv koliko je i divan.

Osvajanje vrha me je emotivno jako pogodilo, na nivou ljudskosti - kao kada sam pročitao The Climber-a, iako su potpuno različiti. Pobeda takve prirodne sile jednostavno nema premca

title: Iron Lung
review:
Vrlo ubedljivo snimljeno, vrlo napeto, vrlo impresivno, iskr hell yeah

Volim klaustrofobični horor i horor morskih dubina, tako da mi je ovo vrlo leglo

Sama premisa filma je jako kreativna, tako da pohvale idu i kreatoru igrice

Svaka scena gde se koristila podmornička kamera je bila stravična

Zamerka je što ne volim kada filmovi koriste tripovanje kao način pomeranja plota jer se time može izmisliti štagod umesto nešto što odgovara dosad kreiranom svetu

Mark je sebi stavio veliki izazov time što je odabrao film takav da se u njemu pretežno samo on pojavljuje, tako da je celo breme glume na njemu - početniku, ali iskreno lepo je odglumio

Sve u svemu svaka čast za Markija i ekipu 🙏

title: Deadpool & Wolverine
review:
BANGER

Deadpool is Deadpool, I love him

Wolverine is great, and the two of them together are a great duo to watch… I need more Hugh and Ryan teamups

The fights are excellent, and surprisingly, there is an impressive one-take fight scene

I had a bit of a rough time because I haven't yet seen Logan and some X-Men movies

One personal complaint is that this is yet another multiverse story… Yes, the movie does make fun of multiverse movies, but it's still one of them. The first movie is the best thanks to the low-budget and small-scaled story, among other factors

It's a shame that this is another one where you “have” to watch some spinoffs to understand the whole plot

Of course, I didn't figure out all the jokes, but all in all the dialogue, cameos, fights, and situations are all just hilarious 

So many fucking great lines 🗣️🗣️‼️‼️

title: Dune: Part Two
review:
Beautiful cinema experience, especially in IMAX.

The cinematography is unbelievable, the CGI is first class, the vehicles, the constructions and the visual effects are all incredibly realistic

The SFX and the score go HARD.

Production wise, the black-and-white scene is an absolute standout. Saying that it leaves an impression is one hell of an understatement.

The actors do a great job with the roles they're given. Austin Butler as the ultra-bald guy is perfect casting. Timothée Chalamet feels like the right choice for a character like Paul, and he delivers on some pretty intense scenes. Javier Bardem as Stilgar was my personal favorite.

Regarding the story... I see the potential. But to me, most of the characters in Dune are pretty forgettable. The main issue is that some crucial things are genuinely rushed... 

Zendaya hooks up with Paul after 5 minutes... the ultra bald guy is introduced late and, while well acted, is very weak as a character... also suddenly there's a warehouse full of nukes... and my main one, Paul flips his whole philosophy literally in a moment, thanks to the suddenly introduced magic water...

The deaths are very anticlimactic and there are a number of unnatural transitions which further point out that things have been skipped.

Nonetheless, I feel like I will like the third part.

I need a bro like Stilgar to be my wingman.

review:
This movie is one of the most stylized and well animated movies out there holy shit

The Metro Boomin soundtrack is full of bangers as expected.

The story is really fun, and although this is basically a part 1, it’s not suddenly cut. The next movie is well set up.

The characters shine, Gwen is great, Miles is even better than before, the main villain is pretty damn fun, Miguel is great, HOBIE IS THE GOAT THOUGH

I love the way the movie explored the Spiderverse. Loads and loads of different spideys all throughout the movie. SO MANY REFERENCES TO POINT OUT!

I have to wrap it up by mentioning the animation and style again. From a purely artistic standpoint, this movie is a masterpiece. From the first goddamn frame. So many passion is behind this project.

👏👏

title: Bullet Train
review:
Diesels man, they’re the worst!

Bullet Train is not objectively a 5 star movie, but goddamnit, if I didn't have more fun with this one than most of other movies I've seen!

Such a lovable action comedy. It had me laughing out loud a couple of times, I was so surprised!

Character banter is top tier. All of the side characters were great fun. It feels like literally every actor had fun making their scenes, it brings such a great atmosphere.

Tons of tiny details that foreshadow all kinds of events that happen throughout the movie, from the very first minute. It's extremely well done!

This movie takes Chekhov's gun and fucking USES IT. 

Also, the music brings a lot of hype, and the colors make a lot of the scenes stand out. It's just greatness all around.

What a fun piece of cinema.

Star Wars: The Force Awakens
review:
Somehow didn't log this earlier. 

Watched it at release in 2015. Everyone was rightfully hyped for the return of Star Wars. It was a great experience to see a new Star Wars entry on the big screens.

The movie showed solid promise back then. Finn had great potential as a Stormtrooper-turned-Jedi, but we know how that played out. Kylo Ren was a great Sith to say the least.

The movie played out pretty similarly to the first Star Wars movie, so it wasn't that innovative.

What a shame how this trilogy turned out.
